name: Criminal Intelligence Dashboard - لوحة معلومات الرصد الجنائي

parameters.query: SELECT report_type, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE email_sent) AS emails_sent, MAX(created_at) AS last_run FROM reports GROUP BY report_type
SELECT id, report_type, report_title, report_title_ar, report_date, email_sent, created_at, references_count, word_count FROM reports ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, title, title_ar, authors, source_type, source_name, url, crime_type, region, publication_date, date_added FROM criminal_references ORDER BY date_added DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', date_added), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM criminal_references WHERE date_added >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
